'''Shuncai''' is a  NPC in {{location|Jinzhou}}.
Originally a customer, Shuncai now works with [[Panhua]] to gain experience to run his own stall.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Before)
:'''Shuncai:''' I still dream of starting a small stall...

;(After)
